title: Email Validator
description: Validate emails via syntax + DNS (no SMTP probing, no emails sent).

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses to validate. Entries may also be comma/semicolon/newline separated lists or 'Name <addr>' forms.

checkDns.title: Check DNS (MX)
checkDns.description: Look up MX / A records over DNS-over-HTTPS to confirm the domain can receive mail.

checkSpfDmarc.title: Check SPF / DMARC
checkSpfDmarc.description: Also report SPF and DMARC presence and DMARC policy for each domain.

allowRoleAccounts.title: Treat role accounts as valid
allowRoleAccounts.description: If false, role addresses (info@, sales@, support@…) get verdict 'risky'.

allowDisposable.title: Treat disposable domains as valid
allowDisposable.description: If false, disposable/temporary inbox domains get verdict 'risky'.

allowFreeProviders.title: Treat free providers as valid
allowFreeProviders.description: If false, free webmail (gmail.com, outlook.com…) gets verdict 'risky' (useful for B2B lead lists).

maxEmails.title: Max emails
maxEmails.description: Safety cap on unique emails per run.

checkDomainAge.title: Check domain age (RDAP)
checkDomainAge.description: Look up the domain's registration date over RDAP (servers from the IANA bootstrap only). Domains under 30 days old raise the risk score. Fails soft: unknown age is null.

cacheDomainAge.title: Cache domain age for 30 days
cacheDomainAge.description: Store RDAP registration dates (domain names and dates only, no email addresses) in a named key-value store 'fairquery-email-rdap-cache' in your account, so repeat runs are faster. Turn off to keep nothing between runs.

millionVerifierApiKey.title: MillionVerifier API key (optional, BYOK)
millionVerifierApiKey.description: Optional. Your own MillionVerifier API key (app.millionverifier.com/api). If set, emails that are not already invalid or disposable are also checked by MillionVerifier using YOUR credits, and each real result is charged the separate 'mailbox-checked-byok' event. The key is encrypted by Apify, never logged, and never written to the dataset, key-value store or run summary. Emails are sent to MillionVerifier (your processor).
millionVerifierApiKey.sectionCaption: Optional mailbox check (bring your own key)

mailboxCheckMaxPerRun.title: Max mailbox checks per run
mailboxCheckMaxPerRun.description: Hard cap on MillionVerifier calls per run (protects your vendor credits).
